title: RefineEvo: Planning-Guided Heuristic Evolution with Bidirectional Experience
claim: Search is made adaptive by a planner that picks operators, an evolver that generates, and a reflector that stores reusable lessons.
layout: Top flowchart loop above three module panels, left-to-right, with population cylinders at the ends
description: A dense framework diagram. The top strip is a loop flowchart: Current Population, Select Operator (diamond), Exploration or Exploitation Mode, Improve Operator, op1 and op2, Generate, Offspring, Evaluate, Population Management and Next Population. An Update arrow returns to the start. An Experience Pool box connects to Generate and Evaluate through Retrieval and Extract arrows. Below, three colored panels carry robot icons. The green Planner panel lists op1 to op5 under exploration and exploitation, with prompt bubbles for Operator Refinement. The blue Evolver panel shows parent and offspring code snippets. Python, Eval. set and Fitness icons sit to the right of the Evolver. The teal Reflector panel at the bottom holds Negative Experience, Trajectory and Positive Experience boxes, joined by fitness up and down arrows. Population cylinders with code cards sit at both ends.
caption: The overall framework of RefineEvo. At each generation, the Planner perceives population and operator statistics to select a search mode and trigger operator refinement when needed. The Evolver generates offspring using the selected operators and retrieves relevant experiences from the Bidirectional Experience Pool (BEP). The Reflector evaluates parent-to-offspring trajectories and distills structured experiences into the BEP.
abstract: Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) has emerged as a transformative approach for solving combinatorial optimization problems. While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods have shown promise, they predominantly rely on fixed evolutionary operators and struggle to effectively accumulate and reuse historical search experience. This paper proposes RefineEvo, a novel evolutionary framework that transforms AHD from a static trial-and-error process into a planning-guided, experience-driven system. RefineEvo introduces a Planner to dynamically schedule evolutionary operators and trigger refinement based on the current search state, and a Reflector to distill valuable lessons into a Bidirectional Experience Pool containing both positive insights and negative pitfalls. This synergistic framework enables the system to adapt its search tools to the evolving complexity of the problem and leverage trajectory-aware, situation-conditioned insights to guide generation. Experiments on several classic combinatorial optimization benchmarks demonstrate that RefineEvo consistently outperforms strong baselines. In particular, RefineEvo delivers superior solution quality while improving token efficiency, enabling more efficient and autonomous heuristic design.
